title: DREW SANDERS 2023 SELECT CONCOURSE LEVEL SILVER DIE CUT RC DENVER BRONCOS
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2023 Panini Select sports trading card features Drew Sanders, a rookie player from the Denver Broncos team in the National Football League (NFL). The card is a die-cut parallel/variety, with a card number of #30. It belongs to the Concourse Level set and is not autographed. 

This trading card is perfect for any football enthusiast and collector, especially those who admire the skills of Drew Sanders. It is a great addition to any sports trading card collection and is sure to impress with its unique features. Get your hands on this 2023 Panini Select Drew Sanders card and add it to your collection today!
